entries.en: ragged and dirty; unkempt, tattered (of clothing)
dirty; filthy, foul
entries.notes: M 栏「o ô」残缺，据 L「sucio」与 H「穢」及闽音互证释义。

entries.en: dirty, filthy; very dirty, covered with grime
entries.notes: L「sucio muchos」意为很脏，M 音写「caunge gu cau」残缺且难与 H「污」逐字对应，取 L/H 共义。

entries.en: dirty, filthy; foul
entries.notes: M「o thog, o」残缺，H 字有「齷/垢」之疑，据 L「sucio muchos」与闽入声音写释义。

entries.en: dirty with mud, mud-stained (sucio de barro)
entries.notes: M「o combarro」残缺且疑夹西语 barro（泥），据 L「sucio de barro」（沾泥之脏）释义。

entries.en: ragged, dirty clothes; a soiled or tattered shirt

entries.zh: 肮脏难看；生疮瘢而污秽
entries.en: dirty, foul-looking; grimy, scab-scarred
dirty, filthy; unclean
dirty and ugly; squalid, ill-favored

entries.zh: 恶浊；一切污秽（原注 todo el sucio：凡脏皆属此）
entries.en: foul, filthy; every kind of dirt ('todo el sucio')

entries.zh: 触秽、沾染污秽；礼仪上的不洁
entries.en: to touch or contract defilement; unclean, dirtily (suciamente)

entries.zh: 做污秽的举动；行肮脏之事
entries.en: to commit a filthy act; to behave dirtily
entries.notes: L 词头残缺（「m̂octada」难辨），据 H「穢舉動」（污秽举动）与 M「ve cu tong」释义。

entries.zh: 道德上的不洁；心术污秽
entries.en: morally unclean, impure; defiled in conduct
dirty, filthy; extremely dirty
entries.notes: L/M 均残缺（「o[?]elo」「yñunñu, ho」难解），据 H「污穢」与 L 词头「sucio」释义。

entries.zh: 污渍；衣上面容上的脏迹
entries.en: stains, spots of dirt (on clothes and face); soiled
dirt, filth, grime (noun)
bodily dirt; grime on the skin
entries.notes: M「cauque ut hunnpo」残缺难全解，据 H「垢膚」与 L「suciedad del cuerpo」（身上之脏）释义。

entries.zh: 内里的污秽；里面的脏物
entries.en: interior dirt; filth within
entries.notes: M 附注「interiores」残缺，据 H「穢內頭」（里面的秽）与 L「suciedad interior」释义。

entries.zh: 出汗、流汗；汗珠；发汗（如病人发汗）
entries.en: to sweat, perspire; sweat (noun), beads of sweat; to sweat out (as the sick do)
entries.notes: M 栏残缺并夹西语注「ut el enfermo」（病者亦出汗），据 L「sudar-sudor」与 H「汗」及「汗珠」「发汗」音写释义。

entries.en: to sweat, sweat flowing
